name: Language server setup brief
responsibility: Writes the brief that tells an agent how to set up the missing language servers of a checkout
description: It sits beside the configurable languages in the browser-safe languages entry. One brief serves archboard init and Fix with Codex. It names the languages that lack a server and tells the agent to follow the repository's own rules for development tools, to show its plan first, and to write .archboard/language-servers.json. Choosing a terminal agent and starting it stay in the CLI.
